Role Summary

The Academic Dean leads the instructional team and is the school's authority on academic standards at MiaPrep Online Academy of Ohio (MOAO), including student conduct, attendance compliance, and academic integrity. This person is the primary leader for teacher supervision and development, oversees academic data and testing coordination, and works closely with the Student Support team (counselors and advisors), who lead student interventions and support. As a member of the MOAO leadership team, the Academic Dean contributes to schoolwide strategy and helps keep instruction, student culture, and compliance with Ohio requirements working together.   • Directly supervise instructional staff, holding weekly 1:1s focused on coaching, support, and goal setting.

  • Lead recruiting, onboarding, and training for new teachers.

  • Observe live instruction and office hours on a bi-weekly basis and provide actionable feedback.

  • Monitor grading practices to ensure students receive timely, high-quality feedback.

  • Complete annual and semi-annual walk-throughs and performance reviews as outlined by the ODEW and manage bi-weekly timecard approvals.

  • Coordinate instructional and grading coverage for teacher absences.

  • Address performance concerns through clear expectations, documentation, and, when needed, formal improvement plans in partnership with People Operations.

Student Conduct, Attendance & Academic Integrity

  • Own the school's student conduct process, from initial report through investigation, determination, and documentation, applying policy consistently and fairly and creating policy where needed.

description:

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

QV.AC is a general purpose AI assistant that runs locally on your devices. It gives people real control over their data and how they use AI. No cloud dependency, no data harvesting, and no one else's servers between you and your assistant. Our focus is local, on-device, privacy-preserving AI, connected across Tether's peer-to-peer ecosystem. We're building the AI assistant people actually own. Product sets the direction.

We're looking for a Product Engineering Lead to turn that direction into features people love, built to a standard that holds up on real devices with real constraints. You lead the teams that build QV.AC's features and app experience on top of our local AI stack, each with its own lead. You report directly to the CTO and take direction from product. Product owns the what and the why. You own the how and the engineering bar.

The split is roughly 70% engineering leadership and 30% product. You're a combination of three things. You're an engineering leader who has helped teams ship consumer products at speed. You have real product sense and can partner with PMs as an equal, shaping what gets built, not just executing it. And you have an intuition for AI systems and their limits, so you can turn emerging capabilities into features that work reliably on-device, without needing to build the models yourself.

  • Leadership - Create clarity around team goals and make sure everyone knows what success looks like.- Mentor team leads to build strong team operating systems, improve how their teams work with others, and grow as leaders.- Lead by example: roll up your sleeves when the team needs it, and step back when they're ready to own it.

  • Strong product sense: you can tell a good feature from a busy one.

  • Intuition for applied AI and on-device constraints: model size, latency, memory, battery, and the gap between a good demo and a reliable feature. You don't need ML research expertise, because our core abstracts it away.

  • You use AI tools heavily in your own work and enjoy experimenting with new models and capabilities.

  • Deep JavaScript and React.

  • Initiative, curiosity, resilience, and the ability to give and receive direct critique.

Preferred:

  • Bonus: Experience with local or on-device inference, LLM evals, cross-platform mobile and desktop apps, or open source.

  • Bring a strong point of view to senior conversations, challenge assumptions constructively and influence decisions across the business.Â

  • Design human-centred AI experiences with appropriate trust, explainability, user control and clear handoffs, including agent and assistant experiences that work across multiple surfaces such as the Fuel50 platform, Microsoft Teams and Copilot.Â 
  • Grow our design engineering capability, and be comfortable building and shipping working prototypes or code yourself.Â 
  • Evolve our design system, accessibility standards (including WCAG compliance) and design-to-code practices so Fuel50 feels coherent and high quality across every product.Â 
  • Shape design team structure, capability, hiring, planning and ways of working as the organisation evolves.Â 
What you'll bring:
  • Experience in product design in a SaaS or technology environment (we suggest 7 or more years), including at least 2 years leading, managing or coaching designers, and a track record of building healthy, high-performing teams.Â

  • The ability to think big and set a compelling vision, while staying pragmatic about what can be learned and shipped next.Â 
  • The ability to originate ideas and direction, and to communicate them clearly through stories, prototypes and design narrative.Â

  • Experience working closely with Product and Engineering as a genuine cross-functional trio.Â

You should be comfortable building working prototypes using HTML, CSS, JavaScript or similar tools, and have contributed code that has shipped to production, for example front-end changes or design system components submitted through pull requests.Â

  • An interest in design systems and data-informed decision-making.Â

  • Comprehensive fully subsidised health insurance with Southern CrossÂ 
What's it like to be a Fuellie?

Fuel50âs team is fully remote, with an HQ in New Zealand, and team members across five countries. If youâre based outside of Auckland and are needed on-site for anything, weâll pay for you to get here.Â 

We know that having the right people with the right attitude and behaviour is a big part of what makes us successful.Â  Living our values is an important part of being successful in this role.Â Â

  • We have #SuperheroAwards at quarterly planning meetings and spontaneous recognition and shout-outs across the business.Â Â

Job Title: Director, Payment Integrity

Reports To: Vice President, Operations

This is an exempt position reporting to the Vice President, Operations. The Director of Payment Integrity is responsible for the Quality Assurance, Grievances & Appeals, and Fraud, Waste & Abuse teams. This role functions as both the director setting strategy for these departments and the direct supervisor managing day to day operations. This position interfaces with all departments of SIHO as well as external stakeholders, vendors, and customers. The ability to interact with all levels of SIHO staff and external parties with a high level of professionalism, while adapting quickly between multiple high priority items, is essential.

Brief Description of Duties:

  • Directly supervise and manage the Quality Assurance, Grievances & Appeals, and Fraud, Waste & Abuse teams, including day to day oversight, staffing, and performance management
  • Read, research, and interpret federal and state regulations governing grievances and appeals, and translate regulatory requirements into practical, actionable process changes

  • Support the claims and benefit configuration quality assurance program, including developing and delivering training and education for staff

  • Manage data transfers with vendor partners, meet with vendors regularly to ensure processes are working as intended, and escalate potential issues as they arise
  • Interact directly with customers as needed
  • Work with SIHO Legal and key leadership on special cases and external inquiries from CMS, the Indiana Department of Insurance, law enforcement, and others

  • Lead or support key corporate and departmental compliance initiatives, including SOC audits, CMS Part C Reporting and ODAG, and others as assigned

Minimum Skills Requirement:

  • B.S. degree or equivalent work experience in a healthcare operation
  • 3-5 years experience in a managed care environment
  • Strong understanding of federal and state regulations related to grievances and appeals, including CMS and state Department of Insurance requirements
  • Experience across Medicare Advantage, ACA, employer group/TPA, and MEWA products preferred
  • Demonstrated ability to lead and manage people and teams, while also directly supervising staff on a daily basis
  • Proficient in Excel with the ability to analyze data and draw actionable insights
  • Thorough understanding of medical and health plan terminology; familiarity with CPT, HCPCS, and ICD-10 coding a plus
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly communicate with all levels of management as well as external entities, vendors, and customers
  • Ability to work successfully at a self-directed pace in a changing, fast-paced, high demand environment, adapting quickly between competing high priority items
  • Ability to work successfully under tight deadlines
  • Experience with SIHO systems including the HSP claims system
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office suite products including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook

All positions are subject to change based on the needs of the business.

title: Technical Product Manager AI Stockbroking App
description:
About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

Â 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Â 

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

KIRA is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

Â 

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

Â 

The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

Â 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

Â 

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

    Â 

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

    Â 

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

    Â 

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Senior Growth Product Manager AI Native
description:
About Magic Eden and Dicey
Magic Eden reached unicorn status in just 9 months after launch, one of the fastest in history. We built a category-defining NFT marketplace from scratch and proved we know how to move fast. Now we're doing it again. Dicey is our crypto casino and sportsbook platform, targeting the $180B+ iGaming and sports betting markets.

We're a small, fully remote team. We ship fast, we're hands-on with our data, and we're rebuilding how a growth team operates around AI from the ground up.

The role
Most of the iGaming industry competes on acquisition. Almost nobody has figured out personalized retention, knowing who a player is, what they need right now, and what would actually change their behavior this week. That's the problem you'll own.

This role focuses on the full post-signup journey: expanding our player segmentation framework, designing and running targeted offers and campaigns, and owning the P&L lever that comes with it. It's explicitly AI-native. You'll build workflows, agents, and pipelines to run lifecycle campaigns that would have taken a whole team two years ago. Half the job is identifying the right problem. The other half is running the experiments to find the answer.

What you'll do

  • Own retention and monetization as a growth loop. Set the targets, find the leverage, and drive the numbers for everything that happens after a player signs up

  • Own the player segmentation framework. Today it's value and risk. You decide how it evolves, what signals feed it, and how the rest of the company uses it

  • Build the AI-native growth stack. Analysis, agents, and automated pipelines that surface segments, generate offer candidates, and run campaigns with minimal manual work

  • Design and ship targeted offers for specific segments and moments: reload bonuses, lossback, wager bounties, challenges, win-back sequences. Size them, spec them, ship them, measure them

  • Spend real time in our data warehouse and on-chain data finding patterns and turn them into campaigns before anyone else does

  • Expand the signals we have on players: on-chain activity, status-match programs, social account linking, and whatever else you can think of

  • Run the campaigns. Email, in-app, Telegram, whatever the channel. You're hands-on with it, with AI doing the heavy lifting

  • Partner with engineering and design to ship the product surfaces that make all of this repeatable

What we're looking for

  • Strong intuition for player psychology and incentive design. Experience in gambling, gaming, fintech, or consumer marketplaces helps. Genuine curiosity about why people behave the way they do is required

  • Deeply analytical. You can go from a vague question to a clean cohort cut yourself, without waiting on a data scientist

  • AI-native by default. You already use AI to write queries, build analyses, and automate your own work and you want to push that much further

  • High output with good judgment. You generate a lot of ideas and know which ones are worth testing first

  • Bias to do it yourself. You're comfortable sending the email, running the query, and writing the spec, not just briefing others

  • Comfortable with ambiguity. There's no playbook here, you'll be building it

Backgrounds that tend to fit

  • Growth PM at a data-heavy consumer company

  • MBB consultant who wants to move into product and own outcomes, not just advise on them

  • Product Minded Data scientist or analyst who wants to ship, not just report

Why this is interesting

  • Competitive, top-of-market compensation

  • You're defining what a growth PM looks like in an AI-native company, there's no inherited playbook

  • Personalised retention is where the industry is going and we're building it early

  • Real ownership: a segmentation framework, a product surface, and a P&L lever, with a direct line to the founding team

We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting. Our application focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations

Our objective is to organise anyone's life.

Â 

Role

As a Web Frontend Engineer, you will build the core web experiences, including Chat, Notes, Calendar, Docs and Sheets.

You will own complex, highly interactive product surfaces from architecture through implementation, working closely with product, design, backend and AI engineers to make AI a native part of how users communicate, write, organise and work.

Â 

What You'll Own

  • Build major web experiences across Chat, Notes, Calendar, Docs, and Sheets.

  • Develop complex interactions including real-time messaging, collaborative editing, rich-text editing, scheduling, tables, and spreadsheets.

  • Build reusable frontend architecture and components that work consistently across ActAI applications.

  • Integrate streaming AI responses, proactive actions, and model-driven experiences directly into product workflows.

  • Own frontend performance, responsiveness, reliability and accessibility across browsers and devices.

  • Work closely with product and design to take ideas from prototype to production quickly.

Â 

What We're Looking For

  • Strong experience building complex, production web applications using React, TypeScript and modern frontend technologies.

  • Deep understanding of frontend architecture, state management, browser APIs, and performance.

  • Experience building highly interactive products such as chat, collaboration, productivity, document editing, calendars, or workspaces.

  • Experience with real-time systems, WebSockets, streaming APIs, or collaborative interfaces.

  • Strong product and UI judgment with attention to interaction details.

  • Able to independently own features from technical design through production.

Outcomes

Delinea is a pioneer in securing human and machine identities through intelligent, centralized authorization, empowering organizations to seamlessly govern their interactions across the modern enterprise. Leveraging AI-powered intelligence, Delineaâs leading cloud-native Identity Security Platform applies context throughout the entire identity lifecycle â across cloud and traditional infrastructure, data, SaaS applications, and AI. It is the only platform that enables you to discover all identities â including workforce, IT administrator, developers, and machines â assign appropriate access levels, detect irregularities, and respond to threats in real-time. Join our passionate, global team at Delinea and help us make the world a safer and more secure place. If you're ready to push boundaries and challenge the status quo in security, we want to hear from you.
Â 

Apply today to help us achieve our mission.

Delinea secures human, machine, and AI identities, eliminating standing privilege and reducing the attack surface across on-premises and cloud. As the platform expands into Non-Human Identity governance, AI agent identity, StrongDM, and consumption-based licensing, we are hiring a dedicated leader to own how we package value and price capability across the whole portfolio. This is a horizontal L-1 role, peer to the General Managers of Workforce, Workload and AI, reporting to the Chief Product Officer.

What You Will Own

  • Price and packaging architecture across the portfolio: tiering, licensing metrics, add-on structure, bundling.

  • Proposal quality into our monthly Price Committee: the analysis, the financial model, the recommendation, and the action register through to closure.

  • Discount governance, including band policy and the guardrails behind it.

  • Monetization for new categories: NHI governance, AI agent identity, StrongDM, consumption-based licensing.

  • Commercial readiness at launch, so packaging and pricing ship with the product.

  • The single source of truth for pricing, packaging and quoting guidance, partnering with Product Marketing on seller enablement.

  • Price realization, attach rate and competitive position, informed by competitor pricing, market benchmarks and win/loss data.

What We Are Looking For

  • 12+ years across pricing strategy, monetization, product management or product marketing, including 5+ years owning pricing as a named function.

  • A track record of building a monetization function where none existed: cadence, governance, documentation, analytical bench.

  • Experience preparing and defending recommendations to a formal pricing committee or equivalent decision body.

  • Demonstrated design of tiered packaging for enterprise software, and strong financial modeling (pricing impact, ARR and expansion, discount optimization).

  • Credibility with executive peers, holding a position on pricing under pressure without direct authority over sales or finance.

Strongly preferred

  • Cybersecurity or identity security (PAM, IAM, SIEM, endpoint); exposure to NHI, machine identity or secrets management.

  • Consumption-, usage-, or outcome-based pricing models alongside seat-based subscription.

  • Working knowledge of CPQ (Salesforce CPQ, Apttus); pricing through M&A integration or a major commercial model transition. MBA a plus.

Why Now

Pricing at Delinea has been carried by people doing it well alongside a full portfolio, and the surface area keeps growing. The opportunity is to make monetization a professional discipline, with a decision forum that already works. If you want to own monetization end-to-end rather than manage an approval queue, this role is built for it.

Why work at Delinea?

  • We're passionate problem-solvers helping the world's largest organizations protect what matters most: their human and machine identities.

We take care of our employees. We offer competitive salaries, a meaningful bonus program, and excellent benefits, including healthcare insurance, as well as pension/retirement matching, comprehensive life insurance, an employee assistance program, time off plans, and paid company holidays.

About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

Â 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Â 

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

KIRA is building a AI Finance Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

Â 

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

Â 

The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

Â 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

Â 

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

    Â 

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

    Â 

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

    Â 

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Tessera Labs AI is a technology product firm delivering next-generation, AI-accelerated enterprise transformation programs. This is a highly cross-functional, business-facing role. You will run discovery and design workshops directly with logistics, supply chain, and procurement stakeholders â including ownership of the Indirect Procurement value stream â translate their requirements into working Oracle Fusion design and configuration, and own the documentation trail from business requirement through configuration and test. You will also own the integration design connecting Oracle Fusion to Shopify for e-commerce order and inventory synchronization, and to the client'swarehouse management system(s) for outbound and inbound logistics â alongside integration with adjacent Oracle Fusion modules as applicable.

This is a nearshore delivery role, based in Mexico or Brazil, working in a remote-first model alongside Tessera's distributed FDE delivery and AI engineering teams. Because you will be running workshops and presenting directly tobusiness stakeholders and client leadership, excellent business English â spoken and written â is essential to this role.

Key Responsibilities

â¢ Lead and facilitate business process workshops with logistics, supply chain, procurement, and operations stakeholders to capture requirements for a greenfield Oracle Fusion Cloud implementation, spanning Inventory Management, Order Management, Indirect Procurement, and related logistics processes.

For over twenty years, Chaos has developed innovative technologies serving multiple industries, including architecture and design, media and entertainment, and product e-commerce.   • Experience managing and influencing a low-touch, digital or ecommerce-led purchase journey (funnel, conversion, pricing) is a strong advantage.

  • Previous experience in Architecture, Education, EdTech, or a related vertical is an advantage, but not required.

Required Skills

  • Takes full ownership of commercial outcomes: builds pipeline, closes deals, and drives team performance without waiting to be directed.

  • Leads by example in the field: comfortable coaching team members through live deals and personally engaging in high-priority opportunities where it makes a difference.

When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. title: Product Analyst (f/m/d)
description:
adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile apps growth and monetization. adjoe Ads is our programmatic in-app advertising platform that seamlessly connects advertisers and publishers through direct integration of our Android and iOS SDKs. Every ad decision happens in under 200ms across 10 million daily users, powered by real-time bidding algorithms and user quality prediction models that match the right ad to the right user at the right moment.

Where 50 Billion Daily Predictions Begin

The User Experience team is the origin point of adjoe Ads. Everything the system knows about a user, every prediction the ML models make, every bid placed in an auction. It all starts with code this team ships.

The team owns two responsibilities. On the SDK side, a native Kotlin and Swift code runs inside hundreds of publisher apps. It participates in 120 million daily auctions, renders ad creatives across multiple formats, and captures the behavioral signals that power 50 billion predictions per day. The constraint that defines this work: you're executing inside someone else's app, on someone else's device, with zero tolerance for instability. Every ad impression has to feel native and fast to the user.

On the analytics side, the dashboards, investigation tools, and data frameworks that turn raw data into decisions: real-time revenue performance across active campaigns, infrastructure cost visibility, and data quality assessments. If a number matters to the business or to engineering, this team makes it accessible.


Your Mission & Who We Are Looking For:

  • Auction & Marketplace Analytics: You will monitor core ad exchange KPIs—including bid rates, win rates, timeout rates, eCPM, and render rates—and run deep dives to uncover bidding patterns and supply path optimization (SPO) opportunities. We are looking for someone with 2–3 years of experience as a Data or Product Analyst in AdTech (Programmatic, Ad Exchange, SSP, or DSP) who understands what drives marketplace health and revenue.

  • A/B Testing & Revenue Strategy: You will design, track, and evaluate A/B tests for product features, floor pricing rules, and traffic shaping algorithms. We are looking for a data-driven thinker who loves solving business puzzles, testing commercial hypotheses, and proving what actually moves the needle on product performance.

  • Advanced Data Extraction: You will query massive datasets to turn millions of raw ad events into clear business answers. We need advanced SQL skills to effortlessly query billions of rows, spot anomalies, and translate complex metrics into clear, actionable recommendations for our product and demand teams.

  • Traffic & Cost Efficiency: You will analyze bid request data to identify inefficient traffic and help product managers design smart routing rules. We need an analyst who can balance top-line revenue with operational costs, finding ways to streamline traffic (Queries Per Second) without sacrificing publisher earnings.

  • Executive Dashboarding & Reporting: You will build automated, easy-to-read dashboards that give Product, Engineering, and Demand Partnerships real-time visibility into campaign performance. We are looking for hands-on experience with BI tools like QuickSight, Tableau, Looker, Power BI, or Redash to make key business numbers intuitive and accessible to everyone.

  • Agile Project Execution: You will balance scheduled analytics projects with quick-turnaround deep dives when marketplace metrics shift unexpectedly. We need a hands-on, proactive analyst who thrives in a fast-paced environment and can independently manage multiple analytical priorities.

🌎 We welcome applications from talent worldwide and provide relocation support to Hamburg, Germany for those ready to join our team.

What’s in It for You?

At adjoe, you’re not here to just close JIRA tickets, you’re helping build the infrastructure behind one of the most impactful platforms in adtech. The systems you work on will reach hundreds of millions of users and power billions of decisions every day.

  • Go Big. Own projects with impact on 770M users and push adtech boundaries.

  • Move Fast. Ship solutions multiple times a day, learn from results, and keep momentum.

  • Be Direct. Solve problems openly and collaborate across teams.

  • Thrive Together. Grow with a diverse, global team of people from over 40 different countries that learn from each other.

  • Have Fun. Celebrate wins, enjoy daily victories, and bring your energy.

We welcome applications from people who will contribute to the diversity of our company.

title: Senior Sales Engineer - MENA
description:
Who we are:

Sardine is the leading agentic risk platform for fighting financial crime. Our integrated solution unifies data across risk teams to help organizations stop fraud in real time, prevent AI-driven attacks, and automate fraud and AML operations. Sardine’s platform is strengthened by one of the fastest-growing fraud consortiums in the market, spanning more than 6 billion profiled devices, 800 million consumers, and 3 million businesses worldwide. Leading companies including FIS, GoDaddy, Intuit, Edward Jones, ZoomInfo, and Checkout.com rely on Sardine to secure and grow trust in their products.

Our culture:

  • We hire talented, self-motivated individuals with extreme ownership and high growth orientation.

  • We value performance and not hours worked. We believe you shouldn't have to miss your family dinner, your kid's school play, friends get-together, or doctor's appointments for the sake of adhering to an arbitrary work schedule.

  • We're a remote-first team spread across time zones, so no office to report to - work from wherever helps you do your best work. Just a couple of things to keep in mind: pay is based on where you're located, and you'll need to keep a home base in the country you're hired in. So while we love the "coffee shop today, mountains tomorrow" life, this isn't a passport-optional, work-from-anywhere-on-Earth kind of remote - think flexible within your country, not borderless.

Location:

  • Remote MENA - Preference for Dubai

  • Please note: This role will require up to 50% travel.

 

About the role:

Sales Engineering is a team of subject matter experts who serve as the trusted technical advisor to prospective customers. You will lead prospects through the sales process by connecting their needs to Sardine’s value to win new customers and drive revenue growth. You will deliver best in class product demonstrations, fill out RFPs, and win over our prospective customer’s technical teams with your thought leadership and consultative approach. Internally, your insights from the field will help shape our product roadmap and will pave the way for future customers. You will play a key role in our commitment to customer excellence and allow Sardine to stay ahead of market trends.

The SE team is a high visibility and high impact team. At the intersection of our Go-To-Market and Product and Engineering teams, we serve as the link between our customer’s needs and the Sardine’s capabilities, ensuring our platform is always adding value to our customer’s Fraud and Compliance stack. It's a great role for someone who enjoys learning the intricacies of a product to drive value to prospects, and leading through innovative problem-solving to convert prospects into customers. Variety, ambiguity, innovation, and ownership of complex problems are all big components of this role.


What you'll be doing:

  • Support Account Executives in identifying a prospect’s fraud and compliance needs.

  • Prepare and deliver customized demos that showcase the impact of Sardine’s platform.

  • Interface with Security teams to articulate our security posture and successfully complete security reviews.

  • Complete RFPs for competitive opportunities.

  • Create comprehensive Solution Designs that address our prospect’s needs.

  • Collaborate with peers to improve all processes within the Sales Engineering team.

  • Work together with our product and engineering teams to identify areas for improvement in our product suite and help prioritize and design solutions.

 

What you’ll need:

  • 7+ years prior experience as a Sales Engineer, System Engineer, Solutions Engineer, or similar roles

  • Prior experience in similar roles within the Risk, Fraud, or Compliance domain

  • Experience with APIs, a strong understanding of JSON, and proficiency in one or more of the following languages: Python, JavaScript, Ruby, Go, or Java. Bonus points for knowledge of web development principles and/or the ability to build internal tools using one of these languages.

  • Strong analytical skills: you can dig into the technical details of a problem and turn it into a proposed solution

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced remote environment working with global clients

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate complex technical and business concepts to technical and non-technical personas.

Benefits we offer:

  • Generous compensation in cash and equity

  • Early exercise for all options, including pre-vested

  • Work from anywhere: Remote-first Culture

  • Flexible paid time off and Year-end break

  • Health insurance, dental, and vision coverage for employees and dependents - US and Canada specific

  • 4% matching in 401k / RRSP - US and Canada specific

  • MacBook Pro delivered to your door

  • One-time stipend to set up a home office — desk, chair, screen, etc.

  • Monthly meal stipend

  • Monthly social meet-up stipend

  • Annual health and wellness stipend

  • Annual Learning stipend

About the role:

As a Senior Software Engineer on Camunda's new Data Streaming team, you'll help build a foundational new piece of architecture that changes how customers and internal products access process data. Today, customers have no first-class way to stream their own process data out of Camunda, and Camunda's own analytics product is bottlenecked by querying the same storage the live engine depends on. You'll be part of a greenfield team rebuilding how process data is consumed and served at scale, built on top of a durable, continuously-written streaming layer that decouples data consumption from the live engine. You'll be part of a small team from day one, with real room to shape both the architecture and the team's scope as it matures.

At Camunda, we approach engineering in a holistic manner. As such, you will form strong partnerships with product management, the Data Layer and Distributed Systems teams, QA, and support, and work closely with your peers to not only deliver but directly influence how our data streaming architecture evolves to meet our customers' needs.

What You Will Do:

  • Help rebuild how Camunda's analytics product consumes and serves process data at scale, moving it off the engine's critical path entirely.

  • Design and build the core streaming infrastructure that decouples process data access from the live execution engine, backed by durable, object storage.

  • Build customer-facing data streaming capabilities, including a supported way to integrate with systems like Kafka, so customers can reliably get their process data into their own tools.

  • Make foundational architecture decisions as part of a small, high-ownership team, including how the system guarantees consistency and durability across a distributed streaming pipeline.

  • Participate in L3 support and on-call rotations, partnering with Support and SRE to investigate data layer production issues, and feeding what you learn back into the product.

What You Will Bring to the Role:

Must Haves:

  • 7+ years of experience as a backend engineer, in Java, with a strong focus on distributed or data-intensive systems.

  • Hands-on experience building or operating an analytical serving layer over a table format such as Apache Iceberg or Delta Lake - including experience with an embedded/lightweight query engine (e.g. DuckDB, or similar), or a stateful stream-processing framework (e.g. Flink, Kafka Streams).

  • A track record of working with object storage systems (S3/GCS/Azure or similar) and building reliable, idempotent upload/commit protocols against them.

  • Solid grounding in the reasoning behind correctness and consistency in data-intensive systems (e.g. concurrent writes, atomicity, idempotency).

  • A demonstrated track record of driving a technical initiative through genuine ambiguity in a still-being-designed system, not just extending an established one.

  • Proven experience leading medium-to-large engineering initiatives (3+ months) end-to-end, from solution design, project planning, and coordinating across teams, right through to driving predictable delivery.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills in a remote-first environment: you translate requirements into actionable technical work with Product, and give and receive clear, direct feedback in code review.

Nice to Haves:

  • Experience with Kafka or a similar streaming/event-log system

  • Experience with embedded state stores (RocksDB or similar) for projection/checkpointing workloads.

  • Experience with stream processing frameworks (e.g. Apache Flink), particularly stateful processing with local state backends and checkpointing.

  • Familiarity with object-storage-native streaming architectures (e.g. systems like WarpStream) is a plus, even without direct hands-on experience.

title: Senior AI Engineer, Location AI
description:
Mapbox is the leading real-time location platform for a new generation of location-aware businesses. Mapbox is the only platform that equips organizations with the full set of tools to power the navigation of people, packages, and vehicles everywhere. More than 4 million registered developers have chosen Mapbox because of the platform’s flexibility, security and privacy compliance. Organizations use Mapbox applications, data, SDKs and APIs to create customized and immersive experiences that delight their customers. 

What you'll do

This role is scoped by skill rather than by product. The problems below span multiple departments and show up across our Search and Places data work, our Location and Navigation Intelligence work, and the Platform work that makes Mapbox usable by agents. You'll be hired into one specific team or product area, but you'll work across teams where your expertise meets the highest-priority AI problems. You should expect to move between teams and tech stacks as the work demands.

At this level you own the technical design and delivery of a multi-component AI system, and you are accountable for the quality of what ships in your area.

In this role, you will:

  • Define how the products you own should work, build a measurement framework for it, and build evaluation systems for non-deterministic behavior. Formulate hypotheses around the products we build and seek the signal needed to validate them. Define what a correct result is for a given input and state, determine whether to assemble datasets from real usage or hand-written cases, and gate changes on regression results.

  • Run continuous evaluation of the products we build, whether APIs, SDKs, data representations, or reference applications, from the position of the end user, whether developer, agent, or consumer. Assess the gaps such as misuse of parameters or integration anti-patterns, recommend the fixes, and make sure they land.

  • Own the MVP against an agreed north star technical design, and balance technical perfection against shipping useful increments.

  • Build data pipelines and the tooling around them: ingestion, conflation, entity resolution, quality checks, and the batch and streaming jobs that keep a large dataset current.

  • Track and pull external datasets, models, and benchmarks from published research and open-source releases. Evaluate what fits the problem and constraints , and decide when to adopt what exists versus build your own.

  • Design feedback loops so that using a product generates data that improves it. Instrument systems so failures arrive with enough context to reproduce, then turn the recurring ones into evaluation cases.

  • Design the boundary between a model and the tools it calls. Build or improve the model harness, decide what the model handles, what it delegates, and how to keep it working from the state it actually fetched.

  • Work to a latency and cost target per request: streaming, partial results, caching, model routing, prompt structure.

  • Build the internal harnesses and tools (CLI, MCP, and others) your team needs to iterate quickly, and share the parts that generalize with other teams.

  • Raise the bar on your team through code and design review, and bring other engineers up on eval practice.

  • Some of the technical questions in this area are still open. You will help answer them.

  • Participate in an on-call rotation to ensure our systems remain available to customers 24/7. Team members alternate as the on-call primary responder, which may require immediate response outside normal working hours, including weekends.

What We Believe are Important Traits for This Role

  • Required Education/Certification:

    • Bachelors Degree in STEM discipline and 5+ years of software engineering experience, with production ownership of services, pipelines, or SDKs.

  • Technical Skills & Tools (Must-Haves):

    • 2+ years shipping LLM-backed features to real users, in systems that carried error budgets, on-call rotations, and customers who noticed regressions.

    • Data engineering depth: SQL, at least one distributed processing framework, and experience with pipelines where a wrong record mattered more than a slow one.

    • Fluency with tool calling and agent orchestration, including the failure modes: stale context, hallucinated arguments, silent partial success, unbounded loops.

    • Strong Python or TypeScript, and comfort reading code in whatever language the caller happens to be written in.

  • Core Competencies & Scope:

    • Direct experience or deep understanding of designing evaluations for non-deterministic systems. You can describe a dataset you built and the failure it caught.

    • Working knowledge of more than one agent harness, and opinions about where each of them is weak.

    • Experience diagnosing latency in a distributed request path.

    • Comfort with ambiguity, and the judgment to ship something narrow that works while the general solution is still unclear.

Nice to Have Traits for this Role

  • Geospatial data experience: routing, geocoding, POI or address data, OpenStreetMap, or conflation of overlapping sources.

  • Public API or SDK design experience, particularly for developers you never talk to.

  • Experience building against MCP or similar tool transports.

  • Experience running evals in CI, with a commercial harness or one you built.

  • Automotive, in-vehicle infotainment, CarPlay, or Android Auto experience.

  • Voice pipeline experience: streaming ASR, TTS, barge-in, endpointing, wake word.

  • Work under constrained compute, offline, or intermittent connectivity.

  • Experience operating a product through its first external integrations, where the customer finds the gaps before you do.

Employment Requirements

  • Employment Type: Full-time

  • Weekly Hours: 40 h per week

  • Location/Hybrid Policy: Remote (from any city in Germany)

What We Value

In addition to our core values, which are not unique to this position and are necessary for Mapbox leaders:

  • We value high-performing creative individuals who dig into problems and opportunities.

  • We believe in individuals being their whole selves at work. We commit to this through supportive health care, parental leave, flexibility for the things that come up in life, and innovating on how we think about supporting our people.

  • We emphasize an environment of teaching and learning to equip employees with the tools needed to be successful in their function and the company.

  • We strongly believe in the value of growing a diverse team and encourage people of all backgrounds, genders, ethnicities, abilities, and sexual orientations to apply.

 

How we support you

  • Hybrid/Remote Options: Enjoy flexibility to work comfortably from home or periodically from an office where applicable.

  • Country-Specific Care & Coverage: Private health, dental, and income protection plans tailored to elevate your regional statutory benefits.

  • Family-First Support: Family care, maternity and paternity leave policies to support your growing family.

  • Lifestyle Spending Account: Contributions to support your health, wellness, and personal growth

  • Balance & Brainpower: Mental health support for you and your dependents.

  • Rest & Recharge: Paid time away, company holidays, and generous absence policies.

  • Time Off to Give Back: Dedicated paid volunteering time in addition to your standard PTO.

title: (Senior) React Native Engineer (m/f/x) - Based in Germany
description:
Cara Care, a digital health company backed by Bayer AG, is on a mission to improve people’s digestive health through technology. As we expand our product portfolio and modernize our platform, we’re looking for a versatile, pragmatic, and forward-thinking (Senior) React Native Engineer (m/f/x) to help shape the future of digital therapeutics.

Your Role

You’ll join a cross-functional product team with high ownership, lean processes, and a clear focus: deliver real impact to patients. We’re looking for someone who thrives on solving real-world problems with code, is technology-open, and knows when to build fast and when to build right. You’ll also help us use AI tools and coding agents thoughtfully in day-to-day engineering, turning emerging capabilities into reliable workflows that improve how we design, build, test, and operate patient-facing products.

Your Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and ship high-quality React Native apps for iOS and Android with TypeScript.
  • Use AI coding agents to implement features, refactor code, and generate tests. Define clear tasks and constraints, provide relevant context, and validate the resulting changes through code review, automated tests, and checks on real devices.
  • Own the full mobile lifecycle: architecture, implementation, automated testing, release management, monitoring, and iteration.
  • Integrate native capabilities (push notifications, deep links, biometric auth, camera/sensors); write and maintain native modules when needed (Swift/Kotlin).
  • Drive mobile performance and reliability (startup time, bundle size, memory, battery) and meet accessibility best practices.
  • Set up and evolve mobile CI/CD (e.g., Fastlane, GitHub Actions/Bitrise), internal testing (TestFlight/Play Console), and release pipelines.
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and Medical to explore, define, and deliver patient-centric features, and to improve our current platform.
  • Connect AI-assisted development workflows to design and engineering tools via MCP, for example to access Figma specifications and components, check implementations against designs, and automate repetitive coding and validation tasks. Keep patient data, credentials, and other sensitive information out of unapproved tools and workflows.
  • Uphold technical excellence in architecture, code quality, and security, especially in a regulated healthcare environment, including applicable requirements under IEC 62304, BSI TR-03161, and the MDR.
  • Contribute to a platform that powers multiple regulated digital health products across indications like IBS, GERD, and upcoming expansions.
  • Mentor other developers and help raise the technical bar across the team.

Requirements

Your Profile

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with at least 3 years focused on React Native and shipping production apps.
  • Expert with React Native and TypeScript, React Navigation, state management, and testing (Jest, React Native Testing Library; Detox a plus).
  • Hands-on experience using AI coding agents to implement features, refactor code, and write automated tests, including connecting agents to engineering tools via MCP. You can explain how you scoped the work, verified the results, and handled tool permissions and sensitive data.
  • Proven track record delivering to App Store and Google Play, including handling certificates/provisioning, in-app updates, and staged rollouts.
  • Solid understanding of mobile security and privacy: secure storage, keychain/keystore, certificate pinning, data minimization, and PII handling.
  • Experience with mobile CI/CD and release automation (Fastlane, GitHub Actions or Bitrise), and tools like Sentry.
  • Product mindset: you’ve worked in product-centric teams, collaborated closely with non-technical stakeholders, and care deeply about UX and accessibility.
  • Bonus: experience in regulated industries, healthcare, or other security-conscious environments; native iOS/Android development (Swift/Kotlin)


💡Please note: Cara Care is a remote-first company with a fully distributed team. All team members are based in Germany so candidates must reside in Germany to join us.

Benefits

💸 Fair compensation: We offer fair pay, regular salary reviews, and the equipment you need to do your best work.

🫶 Great team spirit: Join a vibrant, interdisciplinary team and enjoy a friendly, supportive working atmosphere, with regular in-person team events.

👨‍💻 Remote-first working: Prefer working from home? No problem. Want to join us at our Berlin office? That works too. Our remote-first approach gives you the flexibility to work where it suits you best.

🏝️ 30 days off per year: Rest matters. You’ll get 26 vacation days plus 4 additional company-wide mental health days each year to take a breather and recharge.

🦉 Flexible working hours: Whether you’re an early bird or prefer a later start, you can shape your working day around what works for you.

🏋️ Urban Sports Club (USC): Enjoy access to a wide range of sports, fitness, and wellness activities at discounted rates.

🧠 OpenUp: Access a variety of resources and services to support your mental health and personal wellbeing.

🛍️ Corporate Benefits: Get attractive discounts and exclusive offers from a wide range of well-known brands and providers.

🚀 Make a real impact: Be involved, contribute your ideas, and help shape what comes next. Your voice matters, and you can make a real difference.

About Cara Care

Cara Care is a digital health company on a mission to improve the lives of people with digestive health conditions through holistic, science-based digital therapies.

Our established IBS therapy, Cara Care für Reizdarm, provides personalised content, practical exercises, and symptom tracking to help people better understand and manage their condition. It is listed in the German Federal Institute for Drugs and Medical Devices’ (BfArM) directory of digital health applications (DiGA) and is covered by statutory health insurance in Germany.

We are expanding our product portfolio and evolving our technology platform to bring digital therapies to more people across a broader range of conditions.

Backed by Bayer

We’re proud to share that Cara Care has recently joined the Bayer Group, a move that strengthens our mission and enables us to scale our impact even further. With Bayer’s global healthcare expertise and our innovative digital approach, we’re poised to redefine care for digestive health.

What It’s Like to Work With Us

At Cara Care, you’ll be part of an interdisciplinary team of doctors, designers, engineers, and creatives who are deeply passionate about improving lives. We’re inspired by our patients and driven by real-world impact. We move fast, collaborate closely, and never lose sight of the importance of well-being—both for our users and ourselves.

Diversity Matters to Us

We believe that diverse teams build better products. That’s why we’re committed to creating an inclusive environment for everyone—regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, or disability.

title: Kundensupport (m/w/d)
description:
Angefangen hat alles vor sieben Jahren als ambitionierte Idee. Heute sind wir Marktführer für Abschlusszeitungen in Deutschland. Jedes Jahr nutzen mehr als zwei Drittel aller deutschen Abschlussjahrgänge die nuggit App, um ihre Abschlusszeitung und ihre Abschlusstextilien zu gestalten und sich damit eine Erinnerung an eine gemeinsame Zeit zu schaffen, die bleibt.

Unsere Mission: Durch digitale Innovation und persönlichen Kundenkontakt sind wir für SchülerInnen der verlässliche Partner bei ihrem allerersten großen Projekt. Dafür hinterfragen wir permanent den Status Quo und entwickeln neue, kreative Lösungen.

Wir sind ein kleines Team mit sehr großer Reichweite. Unsere Kunden sind SchülerInnen, die gerade ihre Abizeitung oder ihre Abschlusstextilien planen. Für viele ist das ihr erstes großes Projekt. Im Kundensupport (m/w/d) bist du ihre erste Anlaufstelle: per Chat, Telefon und Videocall, von der ersten Frage bis zur Lieferung. Standardfragen beantworten bei uns Chatbot und Helpcenter, du bist überall da, wo ein Mensch gebraucht wird. Das heißt viel direkter Kontakt, schnelles Feedback und echte Verantwortung.

Aufgaben

  • Support: Du beantwortest Anfragen unserer SchülerInnen per Chat, Telefon und E-Mail. Schnell, freundlich und so, dass sie danach wirklich weiterkommen.

  • Problemlösung: Wenn etwas hakt, etwa bei Freigaben, Bestellungen oder Lieferterminen, findest du gemeinsam mit unserem Operations-Team eine Lösung und hältst den Jahrgang auf dem Laufenden.

  • Begleitung: Du begleitest Jahrgänge von der Angebotsannahme bis zur Lieferung und sorgst dafür, dass kein Projekt untergeht.

  • Video-Sprechstunden: Du führst buchbare Video-Calls, in denen SchülerInnen intensive Unterstützung bei ihrem Projekt bekommen.

  • Self-Service: Du erkennst, welche Fragen immer wiederkommen, und hilfst dabei, Chatbot und Helpcenter besser zu machen.

  • Feedback: Du gibst weiter, was SchülerInnen bewegt, damit wir Produkt und Abläufe verbessern können.

So arbeiten wir

  • Wir sprechen die Sprache unserer Kunden. Unsere Kunden sind 17, 18 oder 19 Jahre alt. Sie melden sich nach der Schule, in der Pause oder kurz vor der Deadline. Sie brauchen jemanden, der geduldig erklärt, verlässlich zurückmeldet und ehrlich sagt, wenn es eng wird.

  • Automatisierung entlastet dich, sie ersetzt dich nicht. Chatbot, Helpcenter und Onboarding-Videos nehmen dir die Standardfragen ab, damit du Zeit für die Gespräche hast, die wirklich zählen.

  • Eigeninitiative ist Pflicht, nicht Bonus. Du bekommst Ziele und Kontext, den Weg gestaltest du selbst. Niemand treibt dich an, aber alle verlassen sich auf dich.

  • Hybrid, ehrlich gemeint. Unser neues Office liegt im Mindspace in der Uhlandstraße 32, direkt am Kudamm und bestens angebunden, mit allen Annehmlichkeiten eines Coworking Space. Alle weiteren Mindspace Standorte kannst du temporär mitnutzen. Homeoffice und mobiles Arbeiten sind selbstverständlich möglich, solange das Ergebnis stimmt.

Qualifikation

  • Du hast Erfahrung im Kundenservice oder Support, idealerweise mit Endkunden. Quereinstieg ist ausdrücklich willkommen, etwa aus Hospitality, Hotellerie, Gastronomie, Einzelhandel oder Jugendarbeit.

  • Du kannst gut mit jungen Menschen: locker im Ton, verbindlich in der Sache und geduldig, wenn dieselbe Frage zum dritten Mal kommt.

  • Du schreibst schnell, klar und freundlich. Am Telefon bist du genauso entspannt wie im Chat.

  • Du behältst auch bei vielen parallelen Anfragen den Überblick. Unsere Saison hat klare Peaks.

  • Du lieferst zuverlässig und meldest dich, bevor jemand nachfragen muss.

  • Du arbeitest sicher mit digitalen Tools wie Chat-, Ticket- oder CRM-Systemen.

  • Du sprichst fließend Deutsch. Das ist bei uns Voraussetzung, weil unsere Kunden deutschsprachig sind.

  • Du hast eine proaktive Haltung und arbeitest gerne eng mit anderen Teams zusammen.

Benefits

Unser Angebot

  • Du begleitest jedes Jahr Abschlussjahrgänge aus ganz Deutschland bei ihrem allerersten großen Projekt

  • Eine Rolle mit Perspektive: Wenn du willst, übernimmst du Schritt für Schritt mehr Verantwortung

  • Ein kleines Team, in dem deine Arbeit direkt sichtbar ist

  • Kurze Wege und offene Ohren: Ideen landen bei uns direkt beim Entscheider, ohne Zwischenebenen

  • 30 Urlaubstage, Firmenlaptop, Sachgutscheine sowie D-Ticket oder JobRad

Die perfekte Bewerberin oder den perfekten Bewerber gibt es nicht. Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung, auch wenn du die Anforderungen (noch) nicht zu 100 % erfüllst, du aber die Motivation mitbringst, dir die nötigen Fähigkeiten anzueignen. Wir begrüßen BewerberInnen verschiedenster Hintergründe, ungeachtet ihrer Geschlechtsidentität, Religion, Ethnizität, nationaler Herkunft, sexuellen Orientierung, Migrationsgeschichte, Alter oder Einschränkungen.

title: Team Lead Fuselage, Doors & Windows (all genders)
description:
Your Mission:

As Team Lead Fuselage, Doors & Windows (all genders) in our Structures Team, you will lead the structural design and development of VÆRIDION’s fuselage, door, and windows work packages for our CS-23 all-electric aircraft.

Your mission is to guide a small team of engineers in delivering lightweight, manufacturable, certifiable, and production-ready structural solutions. You will be responsible for technical direction, work-package execution, team coordination, cross-functional alignment, and delivery quality within your scope.

This role combines hands-on aircraft structures expertise with strong leadership. You will not only execute engineering work yourself, but also enable others, remove blockers, anticipate risks, and represent the Structures function in internal and external discussions.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Lead complete fuselage, doors, and windows work packages independently.

  • Manage, coach, and develop a small team of structures engineers.

  • Set priorities, assign tasks, track progress, and ensure high-quality delivery.

  • Own technical coordination for fuselage structures, door surrounds, window cut-outs, reinforcements, fittings, interfaces, and installations.

  • Drive design maturity from concept through detailed design, prototype build, test support, and production release.

  • Anticipate and mitigate technical, schedule, manufacturing, supplier, and certification risks.

  • Represent Structures in cross-functional meetings, design reviews, supplier reviews, and certification discussions.

  • Align stakeholders across Stress, Systems, Production, Certification, Quality, Procurement, and external partners.

  • Challenge assumptions, bring practical design improvements, and help the team make sound technical decisions.

  • Review key engineering outputs, including CAD models, drawings, interface definitions, and design documentation.

  • Build team capability by improving methods, standards, templates, and ways of working.

 

Your Profile:

  • Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related discipline.

  • 10+ years of aerospace structural design experience.

  • Proven experience leading technical work packages and coordinating engineering teams.

  • Strong leadership skills: clear communication, prioritization, decision-making, conflict resolution, and team development.

  • Experience in at least two full aircraft development programs, such as clean-sheet aircraft, major modifications, prototype-to-certification programs, or production ramp-ups.

  • Strong experience with metallic fuselage structures, aircraft doors, windows, cut-outs, reinforcements, fittings, interfaces, or major airframe assemblies.

  • Strong understanding of metallic and composite aircraft structures, load paths, manufacturability, inspectability, repairability, and certification constraints.

  • Deep proficiency in CATIA V5 or 3DX and configuration-controlled design data.

  • Solid understanding of airworthiness and certification principles related to aircraft structures, ideally including EASA CS-23.

  • Ability to anticipate risks, create clarity, align stakeholders, and deliver results through others.

  • Confidence to represent the function internally and externally.

We recognize that women and other under-represented groups are often overlooked in our industry. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every listed qualification, we still encourage you to apply. Talent and potential can’t always be captured in a checklist.

 

Why us?

  • Be part of an ambitious team determined to shape the future of aviation.

  • We are an in-office company, but we value flexibility and trust employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work or adjusting hours to accommodate personal commitments.

  • Subsidized EGYM Wellpass membership: your (mental) health is important for us.

  • Enjoy a subsidized lunch with a 5€ company contribution per meal on office days.

  • Become a part of our success with virtual stock options.

  • Choose the option that suits your needs: either a free charging station for your electric car or a public transport job ticket as part of the Deutschlandticket.

  • Lease a high-quality bicycle or e-bike through our JobRad program and benefit from tax advantages. Whether for your daily commute or personal use, enjoy more mobility and sustainability.

  • Pension scheme to support your long-term financial security.

  • Work in one of our offices in Munich or Delft. Enjoy the modern Balan Campus in Munich or work inside the aerospace ecosystem at TU Delft.

  • Boost your professional as well as personal growth executing your own ideas and independent projects.

  • Join our internal social events and retreats (e.g. cooking, game nights, sports).

VÆRIDION was founded in 2021 to transform regional air travel with the Microliner, a 100% electric commercial aircraft. By delivering the most energy-efficient aircraft, we are building the future where clean, safe, and affordable electric aviation seamlessly connects people and businesses. We’re bringing together the brightest minds in aerospace, automotive engineering, and business to disrupt the aviation industry.

Aufgaben

title: Staff Technical Program Manager (f/m/d)
description:
We see the potential inside everything and everyone. Starting with you.

Orbem uses AI to industrialize MRI, delivering non-invasive insight into everything from fruits to eggs to the human body. We are transforming what is becoming the world's largest biological dataset into actionable intelligence to reduce waste, increase quality, and accelerate the shift toward a more sustainable and healthier future.

Headquartered and founded in Munich, Germany, with an office now in Houston, Texas, our world-class team is scaling inside-out technology to transform how humanity sees and understands biological matter.

Help us see what's possible. Join us.

Your Role

Orbem is at a critical inflection point. As we scale our range of unique products, we need delivery that is predictable, transparent and built to scale.

As a Staff Technical Program Manager within our TPM team, you will drive the delivery of complex, high-stakes programs that bring our products from development to market. You will work across Hardware, Software and Science/AI, aligning teams around shared goals and turning technical complexity into clear plans and decisions.

This is a high-impact role that blends technical depth, delivery architecture and informal leadership. You will work in a complex, fast-scaling environment, and you will also help strengthen how the wider TPM team works.

Your Day-to-Day

Own the Execution Plan:

  • Architect and design end-to-end delivery plans for your team(s), from initial discovery or design phase until commercial launch.

  • Lead quarterly OKR planning and ensure it is fully aligned to company OKRs.

Lead Cross-Functional Coordination:

  • Co-lead product delivery with the Product Manager and Tech Leads. You own the how and when.

  • Manage dependencies across teams and relevant domains (technical, operations, business development), and keep stakeholders, including external partners, aligned.

Drive Risk & Decision-Making

  • Proactively identify, track, and mitigate technical and non-technical risks — timeline, resources, budget, and scope.

  • Escalate and resolve cross-team conflicts; create the decision-making frameworks other teams rely on.

Shape Ways of Working

  • Champion tooling and process best practices within the team and contribute workflows optimization within the TPM team. (e.g. refine the Product Development Lifecycle, Risk Management processes).

  • Coach and mentor other TPMs.

Your Experience and Skills

  • Program Leadership: Proven track record managing complex, cross-functional technical programs — ideally spanning hardware, software, and/or AI — with high delivery accountability.

  • Technical Depth: Solid understanding of how complex deep-tech products are engineered across Hardware, Software and Science/AI. You can evaluate trade-offs across all three domains well enough to challenge and guide engineering decisions. A technical background in systems engineering, MRI or AI/ML is a plus.

    • Practical understanding of how products are operated at customer sites, from early MVPs to mature deployments.

  • Execution & Planning: Expert in building and managing master program plans, sprint structures, milestone tracking, and risk registers across multiple concurrent workstreams.

    Stakeholder Management: Able to translate technical complexity into executive-level clarity and to influence and align without formal authority across matrixed organizations.

  • Change Management: Proven ability to drive adoption of new tools, frameworks, and processes (e.g. PDLC/PLM rollouts, agile tooling) across cross-functional teams — balancing structured change with the pace of a fast-moving scale-up.

  • Tooling & Process: Advanced setup of planning and tracking tools such as Jira and Confluence, covering portfolio dashboards, cross-team dependency and risk tracking, and executive-ready reporting. Hands-on with agentic AI tools that boost team efficiency.

  • Leadership & Culture: You are a servant leader who thrives in fast-growing scale-up environments, models candid communication, and creates psychological safety in high-stakes settings

What Makes You Stand Out

Experience with deep-tech products involving AI or MRI — or direct exposure to the Food & Fresh Produce industry, particularly melons or soft fruits — is a significant plus. Familiarity with industrializing sensor-based inspection systems for high-throughput agricultural or food processing environments is highly valued.

Fit to Our Values

  • We Own Every Challenge: we enjoy complexity and thrive under uncertainty.

  • We Strive for Better: we seize any opportunity for growth and challenge the status quo. We are constantly learning and improving.

  • We Imagine New Frontiers: we think beyond “doable” and “reasonable”. We design a sustainable and healthy future together.

What We Offer

International Environment:

  • Join a team with 40+ nationalities across 5 continents, all driven by a shared purpose: shedding light on the world’s toughest challenges.

Comprehensive Benefits:

  • Stock Options: Share in Orbem’s success.

  • Relocation Support: Seamless support for your move to Germany.

  • Learning & Development: €1,750 annual budget for personal growth.

  • Fitness Membership: Access to Urban Sports Club or Wellpass.

  • Childcare Reimbursement: Support for Kita/Kindergarten fees.

  • Deutschland Ticket: Monthly subsidy towards public transportation costs.

Work-Life Integration:

  • Flexible Hours & Home Office: Work when and where it suits you.

  • WFH Perks: Get €185 to upgrade your home office + an external monitor on us!

  • 30 Days Paid Leave: Plenty of time to recharge.

  • Personal Leave: Flexibility for life’s important moments.

  • Work From Anywhere: Experience new cultures and environments for up to 60 days per year.

Make a Difference:

Join an ambitious, fast-growing team working on breakthrough technology. In our scale-up environment, you'll have the freedom to lead your projects and make an impact. We provide a platform for you to explore, innovate, and define your vision for the future. At Orbem, we're committed to helping you discover your strengths, and while we aim to teach you, we also want to learn from you.

Your Team:

You'll become part of our diverse and international team. Learn more about the team members, their work, and challenges here: https://orbem.ai/company/

At Orbem, we're committed to building a smart, diverse team, and we recognize that self-doubt can prevent talented individuals from applying. If you feel you don't meet every requirement, we'd love to hear from you anyway!
